rtlCopilot.configuration.title: Noor Smart RTL
rtlCopilot.cfg.font.enabled: Apply the selected font (family/size/line spacing) to RTL chat, Markdown and AI panels.
rtlCopilot.cfg.font.family.md:
Persian/Latin font family for RTL chat and Markdown text. **Code blocks always keep the editor font.** Leave empty to keep the default. You can pick one from your installed fonts with the command below.

[🅰️ Choose from installed fonts](command:rtlCopilot.selectFont)
rtlCopilot.cfg.font.size: Font size (px) for RTL chat and Markdown text. `0` = keep the default.
rtlCopilot.cfg.font.lineHeight: Line height multiplier (1–4) for RTL chat and Markdown text. `0` = keep the default.
